description:
A versatile sleek road machine, perfect for sportives, touring and endurance racing. With its modern geometry, the Pro Lugless Classic delivers a supple ride, effortlessly absorbing bumps and muting road buzz for exceptional, all-day comfort.

The Lugless Classic combines the timeless resilience of steel with contemporary design for optimal performance over long distances. Its fillet-brazed construction eliminates traditional lugs, resulting in a clean aesthetic and reduced weight. Crafted from high-quality Reynolds 725 double butted oversized steel tubing, the Lugless Classic offers a fast and effortlessly compliant ride that will keep you in the saddle during the longest of days.

Hand built in the heart of the UK, the bike comes with carbon forks and disc brakes as standard (rim brakes are also an option). Available as frame-only or fully assembled: choose one of our three assembly packages – or we can help you build up the assembly to your own specification. A fully assembled bike weighs in at just over 9kg (core package).
